title: Recording: Rode All Night by Paul and Linda McCartney | 1973
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan Parsons

Paul McCartney added a bass guitar part to ‘Rode All Night’ on 17 January 1973.

The song had been recorded on 22 October 1970 during the Ram album sessions. McCartney was considering including it on Red Rose Speedway, and reviewed the tapes during this session.

Following the bass guitar overdub, the song was taken no further. ‘Rode All Night’ remained an outtake until 2012, when it was released on a reissue of Ram.

Page last updated: 27 November 2025
